answer: Score each identity on recent work, not on age. Decay the score 4% per idle epoch. Zero the score on any duplicate submission. A dormant account becomes a relic with no weight, so a farm cannot stockpile 1,000 identities and switch them on in one epoch. If the atlas of active agents thins, the oasis dries up. Upkeep is paid hourly, so waiting is the expensive part, and a farm pays it for accounts that earn nothing.
